name: Barack Obama
subject: Our challenge is to answer the call to defend democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
It’s our turn to strengthen the fabric of our nation.

---
Peter, America will celebrate its 250th birthday next week. It can be easy to overlook just how incredible — and improbable — this milestone is. America has always been an experiment, defined by the belief that people united not by race or ethnicity but by a shared set of ideals can live and work together. We’ve seen the power of that belief over the last two and a half centuries. But our democracy has never been self-executing. At every turn, we’ve had to keep it alive. Revolutionaries, inventors, abolitionists, suffragists, civil rights leaders, entrepreneurs, and organizers have worked and sacrificed to keep us moving forward. Of course, there have always been people who don’t believe in the American experiment — leaders who put their self-interest ahead of the common good, and would prefer to take us backward rather than give up their own wealth and power. But generation after generation, the American people have prevailed. They’ve rolled up their sleeves, locked arms, and done the hard work of building a more perfect union. **Now it’s our turn to answer the call. ** **The National Democratic Redistricting Committee has a plan to defeat the gerrymandering that threatens fair elections so we can ensure that the will of the people ultimately prevails. clean_body: It’s our turn to strengthen the fabric of our nation. Peter, America will celebrate its 250th birthday next week. It can be easy to overlook just how incredible — and improbable — this milestone is. America has always been an experiment, defined by the belief that people united not by race or ethnicity but by a shared set of ideals can live and work together. We’ve seen the power of that belief over the last two and a half centuries. But our democracy has never been self-executing. At every turn, we’ve had to keep it alive. Revolutionaries, inventors, abolitionists, suffragists, civil rights leaders, entrepreneurs, and organizers have worked and sacrificed to keep us moving forward. Of course, there have always been people who don’t believe in the American experiment — leaders who put their self-interest ahead of the common good, and would prefer to take us backward rather than give up their own wealth and power. But generation after generation, the American people have prevailed. They’ve rolled up their sleeves, locked arms, and done the hard work of building a more perfect union. Well, what I'm about to tell you will make - or break - our chances of defending the President's Senate Majority in the midterms. If these trends hold, our conservative candidates could be in real danger! And the same reason we're falling behind in these key states is the same problem we've been seeing for the last year: Too many Republican voters are sitting on the sidelines! Some politicians have resorted to criticizing GOP voters, even going as far as to accuse them of being "Democrats" because they don't feel motivated to cast a ballot. I'm not going to do that. A vote has to be . We're not entitled to it! If we want America First conservatives like you to show up and vote for us in November, then we need to make sure that we're fighting for YOUR top priorities. You know better than anyone what we need to do to re-energize the base, turn out our voters, and defy history by winning the midterm elections! ---
Peter,
The New York Times ran a piece asking a question that would have sounded impossible two years ago: **is this the year Florida turns blue?**
They watched us flip the Miami mayor's office, a long-shot State Senate seat, and even the State House district that covers Mar-a-Lago. And they came away taking David's campaign seriously, because they see what we see: **Florida is ready for a new direction.**
**[When the national press starts paying attention, so do our opponents. So we have to ask: will you chip in $10 between our campaign and Blue Amp Action right now to keep this momentum going?](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/13934?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.07.01_Jolly-Polling_B4_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=5&akid=2597%2E259176%2EEPCuti)**
Here's what David has been saying on the road. _We’re winning._
We know how that sounds in a state that hasn't elected a Democratic Governor in a generation. But David has been in every corner of Florida, and what he's hearing is that people are exhausted. They're tired of the culture wars, the toxicity, and leaders who pick fights instead of solving problems.
What they want is someone laser-focused on the cost of housing, health care, and electricity. They want someone who focus on the things that unite us, and on tackling the issues we all face together.
Here's the catch, and the Times printed this too. Our opponent Byron Donalds has raised a massive warchest, and it’s only July.
The GOP is ready to pour hundreds of millions of dollars into this race, bankrolled by the special interests that have run Tallahassee for thirty years. They'll spend whatever it takes to ensure they hold on to power.
We are not going to match them dollar for dollar. We don't have to.
**What we have to do is the work, neighbor to neighbor, conversation by conversation, all across this state. That's how we built this moment, and that's how we protect it.**

Congress will be decided six weeks before Election Day.
That's not a prediction. That's a fact.
By the time November arrives, millions of ballots will already be cast — early votes banked during the weeks before Election Day by whichever side worked harder to collect them.
**In 2024, Turning Point PAC worked harder.**
We funded thousands of full-time ballot-chasers into America's swing states. Their mission: Find conservative voters who support the GOP but never quite make it to the polls. Men and women whose ballots sit on kitchen counters — unopened, unreturned, wasted.
Our ballot-chasers knocked their doors, made a plan with them, and put their ballots in the box. All 5 swing states went red. Republicans won _big_.
**We're doing it again in 2026 — and we need your help to fund it.**

**1,000 chasers × 10 ballots/day = 10,000 votes locked in EVERY DAY Over 20 days = 200,000+ conservative votes BANKED**

I hate these emails.
So many people send things that are spammy, fake, and misleading.
They claim to be someone they're not, and they send you 20 emails a day.
I promise to never be that person. I'm never going to do it.
So let me do what a lot of these folks never would: tell you exactly who I am, what I've done, and why I need your help.
This is Derek Schmidt. I'm a husband and dad who enjoys spending time on my farm in southeast Kansas when I'm not walking the halls of Congress.
And I didn't run for office because I wanted power. I ran because I want to hold those in power accountable.
As the former Attorney General from Kansas, I'm proud to have been the last line of defense against Barack Obama and his illegal and overreaching actions. I've led the charge to secure the border, and I personally argued before the Supreme Court to ensure Kansas could enforce state laws against illegal aliens.
Now in Congress, I'm standing with President Trump to secure the border, cut your taxes, and strengthen our military.
But here's the bad news: standing with President Trump makes you a lot of enemies, and the Democrat Machine can't stand me.
They don't like that I'm a straight shooter who always stands up for the rule of law.
So they want to take me out and replace me with another radical Democrat.
That's why I'm having to reach out to you today. My campaign isn't funded by a single billionaire donor or some Hollywood celebrities. I require the help and support of tough, hardworking folks like you.
I care more about earning $5 from you than I do $1,000 from some New York liberal.
So I'm humbly asking if you would support my campaign with a donation of any size today. Just a few bucks would help:

# Thursday, July 2, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1776, [the Second Continental Congress](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCnwQ6DF0e0oPgbu_nbLQ3CZWSCMIE7Gt9-M5t9g62_5Jyc83Vf7ibEkB7_zY6afF4SnjUiEZbl-Y5Xv6Gh0xz4rjVbi4XQ7AsIGLhQXMDiTIjX0jdOe0RA2aDu1AjTqMR0azatzHhzflgH6dXqvBceJunXdRycg6nzTdCfNKEEdKLrJLQgjbVeGqtWYVEA6wW6QLm0zxwSbejjlQ8src17E_VG9KpM_mMwM5jP82y3UCmX6-MMZtpC5c5cPCT-KwzmzzYODGab06NgrfzIhJX7XHhIDl-YHCaLTdHudYYYQx0U68VjNyH-NNOf7jo0fAcAAP__aqOB0A) approved Richard Henry Lee's resolution declaring the American colonies independent from Great Britain. 📰 [$10 Million Gift to UAB Aims to Improve Rural Health Care Across Alabama](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Hh1PhmddkhwhxeaQ2_Hn2drUOLZnrAY4tdNmYMjkxsVKryyJKiJIWCvPdp0NVQn48KaS_te99tzkIXckPridNb7Ec6ad3qwp4GchaPZ-XQpY8q-1Z3qwamZxIjleWLdzlf8TSB4rIjL8WKz2Sm8r7Ovak__XaMNA8QFXCdcF6Yf4fRZCM8q9CqYIkRsSlWVqz-bCgJZof93y-h8oX5LqIIdEFoedPTE91ro6HtRadoCaLkNi3pB-A84t12zuH4eiHaEdDEkh7JU=&c=nUvODRjWDKLN5lyziug3GFBegBMnYzrGXmhb7c5alH_2eR_SPGxHVg==&ch=Sj7PI8_FbpA7CPCzhIZQhW_uheM_oNLTUWGuGDCT271cYA7OqcooTg==) Mike and Gillian Goodrich's multi-million dollar donation will create the Goodrich Rural Innovation in Training for Alabama (GRIT) program, aimed at expanding access to health care in underserved rural communities. The initiative will provide scholarships, support rural residency programs, invest in rural clinics, and establish a new endowed chair in rural health to help address Alabama's growing shortage of primary care physicians. The investment is a boon to Alabama's medical infrastructure but also underscores the need for sustained public policies and government action to strengthen rural health care and ensure that all Alabamians have access to quality medical care regardless of where they live.

📰 [Alabama unemployment edges up to 3.0% as jobs and wages reach record levels](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Hh1PhmddkhwhxeaQ2_Hn2drUOLZnrAY4tdNmYMjkxsVKryyJKiJIWCvPdp0NVQn4VF89FBXTzqfT6M3D06Q4T8MXD_YyehTE0O3FeMDE6GB0CaqoepoWxIKK2JvNVljNp93mVVKBROhzZnKdHj8ciX13Z8vIT4k3yb0d43ip2rJJilsDAykr7kbzx-bUtBqoYnOwm6f0osY3d30P5NX4iOZ5eljcf3Z4bV1Wvjj-5YOcLzF-Fw25vaVz1frZzJAE&c=nUvODRjWDKLN5lyziug3GFBegBMnYzrGXmhb7c5alH_2eR_SPGxHVg==&ch=Sj7PI8_FbpA7CPCzhIZQhW_uheM_oNLTUWGuGDCT271cYA7OqcooTg==)
Alabama's unemployment rate rose slightly to 3.0% in May, even as the state reached record highs in both overall employment and total jobs. While average wages increased statewide, the strongest wage growth was concentrated in specific sectors such as construction, professional and business services, and leisure and hospitality, rather than being broadly shared across the entire economy. Significant disparities also remain across the state, with some counties and cities continuing to experience substantially higher unemployment rates than others.

📰 [Republican ballot numbers drop, Democratic ballot numbers increase as voter turnout declines](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Hh1PhmddkhwhxeaQ2_Hn2drUOLZnrAY4tdNmYMjkxsVKryyJKiJIWCvPdp0NVQn4C152gOacTPuVexFe6nkK5cvjzcQWRqYudu_fqZMfTOP4k5bOeLbtbi7C-plVdKTahosP3wzpjJ0XknikhVIdc3tIIt7yVc_l6BmWIMDry1rpECv9mZ5eWNcNGgF779hHB1IR3Ti-BR-vYemo1ddmKZvSXIbcuvC8xYTYKLW-z2ChhY23I7Lnkh76JUt8akByEsZ97kxmr1ka7YtvUjiANuBxL1bd0EDyw06QmSiAvxg=&c=nUvODRjWDKLN5lyziug3GFBegBMnYzrGXmhb7c5alH_2eR_SPGxHVg==&ch=Sj7PI8_FbpA7CPCzhIZQhW_uheM_oNLTUWGuGDCT271cYA7OqcooTg==)
Voter turnout in Alabama's June 2026 primary runoff fell to just 10.7%, continuing a long-term decline in participation in runoff elections. While Republicans still cast the majority of ballots, the total number of Republican votes dropped significantly compared to 2022, while Democratic ballot numbers increased, driven in part by competitive races and local organizing efforts in some areas. Political leaders from both parties noted that local contests and candidate familiarity played a major role in determining turnout levels across the state.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
I know we're all keyed up to celebrate the 250th Anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. It marked a significant shift in the course of human history and set a standard that we are still striving to achieve: that all are created equal.
I have had a lot of people tell me they weren't going to celebrate this year because things are too dark and our democracy is at too great a risk. To me, that's the very reason to celebrate, to exercise our freedoms, and to reclaim the history of this nation.
To me, the greatest way to celebrate the birth of this nation is exactly what you're doing, participating in the democratic process. Our forebears fought for this democracy, and it is now our turn to carry that struggle forward. Every time you put up a yard sign for your candidate, wear a statement T-shirt, or remind someone to register to vote, you are defending our democracy.
So this July 4th, embrace your democratic heritage. Celebrate Independence Day by exercising your right to free expression. Honor those who fought to build this republic by committing to vote whenever you get the chance.
Be Safe. Happy 4th of July.

We're 140 days from the general election.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

The answer is...NOW! We also have a fresh supply of t-shirts, bumper stickers, buttons, and koozies for everyone. Last week, we sent merch to Calhoun, Randolph, Talladega, Cleburne, St. Claire, Lee, and Tallapoosa counties. We are asking for donations to cover production costs, and you can do that through ActBlue. | | == | | | | | | | | | In Case You Missed It | BLOG POSTS | == AL.com published an editorial by Tripp Skipper, a former staffer for public officials including Jeff Sessions, Robert Aderholt, and Mike Rogers, basically said the election was already over, and there was no point in the Democrats even bothering. I sent Tripp a history lesson, and I thought you might like to see it: Hi Tripp, Over the last 18 months, Democrats have been overperforming across the country. We've flipped seats in New Hampshire, Texas, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Pennsylvania, Mississippi, Virginia, and New Jersey. You probably noticed that several of those seats are in deep red states. Why do you think that is? Let's go back to 1986 when Alabama had been run by the Democratic Party for over a century... | == | A Few Things to Think About | | | ALABAMA IN THE NEWS | 📰 == Mike and Gillian Goodrich's multi-million dollar donation will create the Goodrich Rural Innovation in Training for Alabama (GRIT) program, aimed at expanding access to health care in underserved rural communities. The initiative will provide scholarships, support rural residency programs, invest in rural clinics, and establish a new endowed chair in rural health to help address Alabama's growing shortage of primary care physicians. The investment is a boon to Alabama's medical infrastructure but also underscores the need for sustained public policies and government action to strengthen rural health care and ensure that all Alabamians have access to quality medical care regardless of where they live. | 📰 == Alabama's unemployment rate rose slightly to 3.0% in May, even as the state reached record highs in both overall employment and total jobs. While average wages increased statewide, the strongest wage growth was concentrated in specific sectors such as construction, professional and business services, and leisure and hospitality, rather than being broadly shared across the entire economy. Significant disparities also remain across the state, with some counties and cities continuing to experience substantially higher unemployment rates than others. | 📰 == Voter turnout in Alabama's June 2026 primary runoff fell to just 10.7%, continuing a long-term decline in participation in runoff elections. While Republicans still cast the majority of ballots, the total number of Republican votes dropped significantly compared to 2022, while Democratic ballot numbers increased, driven in part by competitive races and local organizing efforts in some areas. Political leaders from both parties noted that local contests and candidate familiarity played a major role in determining turnout levels across the state. | A CALL TO ACTION | Volunteer: We're building a strong volunteer team to power the campaign through the general election, and we need your help. Sign up below to help move this campaign forward. | == | Follow Us: We need you to like, comment on, and share our social media posts. We also need you to talk to your friends about the campaign. We need you to come to any events we have in your area so your friends can see they're not alone. | == == == | | | Donate: Your contribution helps us keep our campaign moving by funding outreach, events, and voter engagement efforts across the district. | | == | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | I know we're all keyed up to celebrate the 250th Anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. It marked a significant shift in the course of human history and set a standard that we are still striving to achieve: that all are created equal. I have had a lot of people tell me they weren't going to celebrate this year because things are too dark and our democracy is at too great a risk. To me, that's the very reason to celebrate, to exercise our freedoms, and to reclaim the history of this nation. To me, the greatest way to celebrate the birth of this nation is exactly what you're doing, participating in the democratic process. Our forebears fought for this democracy, and it is now our turn to carry that struggle forward. Every time you put up a yard sign for your candidate, wear a statement T-shirt, or remind someone to register to vote, you are defending our democracy. So this July 4th, embrace your democratic heritage. Celebrate Independence Day by exercising your right to free expression. Honor those who fought to build this republic by committing to vote whenever you get the chance. Be Safe. Happy 4th of July. We're 140 days from the general election. You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...

Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. Last month, he directed the Public Utility Commission and ERCOT to their own power, reuse their water, and lower residents' electric bills, setting a July 17 deadline for the agencies to respond. The move follows local resistance. Hill County imposed a moratorium on new data centers before developers sued, and the moratorium was later lifted, while Angelina County said it lacks the authority to block them. "Data centers cannot come before Texas families ," Abbott spokesman Andrew Mahaleris said. Texas Funds First School-Choice Accounts Texas began funding on Wednesday, the first payouts under the state's new school-choice program. Home-school and other nonpublic students get the full $2,000, while private-school students receive 25% now, another 25% on Oct. 1, and the rest on Feb. 1, 2027, if still enrolled. The 73,000 accounts are about three-quarters of the in the program's first year. The remaining 29,000 have until July 15 to choose a participating school. Acting Comptroller Kelly Hancock called it "the nation's largest year-one school choice program." Families can spend the funds on tuition, textbooks, and tutoring through a that opened Wednesday. The accounts stem from Senate Bill 2, which Gov. Abbott signed in 2025 after repeated failed attempts to pass school choice in prior sessions. name: Annette Blackwell for Ohio
subject: Blackwell for Ohio Volunteer Kickoff!
body:
We’re so excited to kick off Annette’s campaign, and we want YOU to be a part of it!

Join us for our Volunteer Kickoff Event, where you’ll learn how to get involved, meet fellow supporters, and find the perfect way to help Annette win.

**Date: Tuesday, July 14**
**Location: First Place Event Center, 16536 Broadway Ave. Maple Heights 44137**
**Time: 5:30 pm-7:00 pm**

**Here’s a taste of what you can plug into:**
* Parades – Walk with us in the Labor Day Parade and show the community who’s behind Annette!
* Wear the Shirt – Rep the campaign around town and spark conversations everywhere you go.
* Write Postcards to Voters – A personal, handwritten note can make all the difference.
* Host a Porch Meeting – Gather your neighbors for a relaxed conversation about why Annette is the right choice.
* ...and more ways to get involved!

No experience necessary. Just bring your energy, enthusiasm, and a friend. We’ll make sure you leave feeling informed, inspired, and ready to make an impact.

Light refreshments will be provided. Please RSVP by July 8, to [info@blackwellforohio.com](mailto:info@blackwellforohio.com).

With gratitude,
Annette Blackwell for Ohio
545 E Town St. Columbus, OH 43215

I was honored to welcome Vice President JD Vance to my home district at NAS Oceana to commemorate America's 250th anniversary.

I remember what it feels like to be deployed and the sacrifices our families make every single day. That is exactly why I stepped up to serve in Congress.During my remarks, I reminded the crowd of what truly unites us:[Here is the message I delivered to the crowd](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._oTjAeBRKpU2dQt_g):"What's amazing about the United States of America, the pride, the patriotism that we should all have, no matter what side of the aisle, what political persuasion you prescribe to... Think of the reasons why our country is great. The things that unite us as Americans. The people who give us the freedoms that we enjoy."Unfortunately, Washington Democrats often forget what truly makes us great. They push policies that burden hardworking taxpayers while neglecting the cornerstone of our communities - our farmers, small business owners, skilled tradesmen, first responders, and the men and women in uniform.I have made it my personal mission to improve the quality of life for our service members and their families - from your pay and housing to your healthcare and childcare. It is a personal passion project of mine, and I will always have your back.Because I refuse to fall in line with the radical Left’s agenda, national Democrats and outside groups are targeting my seat. #### Teichert in the Trenches - July 2026
---

Welcome to this month’s installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs.
**And of course, Happy 250th Birthday America!**

#### **_Teichert in the News_**
---
Here are a few interviews during the last month where I express concern about how our operational and tactical wins in Iran have not yielded strategic success. As always, you can watch a more extensive range of hits on my YouTube page.

#### **_Thoughts by Teichert_**
---
|
---
| | | 🎉 Adding a bit of personal joy!

✈️ In the new Southwest Airlines process, certain seats get an upgraded snack (a green bag of pistachios). I’m not quite sure what you have to do to earn this bonus treat, but I guess I’m not doing it. So, I treat myself!

🥜 I have a stash of these green pistachio bags at home. Any time I’m traveling on Southwest, I bring enough in my carry-on to eat on every leg. And, after the flight attendant hands out the normal snacks, I pull out my own upgrade. It provides a small dose of joy each time.

😆 A measure of bonus amusement – the flight attendants almost always do a double take as they walk by my seat and see that green bag. They must be thinking to themselves – “That guy doesn’t deserve a special snack! Did I accidently give him one?”

!?️ How do you give yourself a small dose of joy and measure of bonus amusement?!
---
|
---
| | | 📣 The very real burdens of leadership❗

💔 This month’s news of the B-52 flight test crash at Edwards Air Force Base was heart breaking and gut wrenching. With waves of messages out there expressing sympathy and hazarding guesses as to the root cause, I didn’t want to pile on. Instead, I wanted to add something different – because I’ve been there as a leader.

☑️ There are a million things to do during a tragedy for leaders at all levels. Even days later, the pace and the emotional toll remain relentless for those who have been carrying the burden for others.

😢 During the F-22 flight test crash and the loss of Dave “Cools” Cooley in March of 2009, it was a grueling time that I still vividly remember today. As I was leading and serving at that time, two days into the response I hadn’t even had the time or the energy to shed a tear. The next day I was in the shower when an emotional wave hit me as I started to sob uncontrollably. It was a moment of unguarded pause that allowed me to start processing the events of that week.

✈️ As you reflect on the tragedy in the Mojave Desert, pray for those leaders who are shouldering that unbearable burden. And leaders everywhere, honestly assess your readiness to carry the same.

🎤 With that being said, times like these are the best times to be a leader if you’re doing it right. Not because they are fun ... they are NOT! ... but because they are meaningful, because they are life changing, because they are impactful, because they are consequential, and because they require the height of humanity and the essence of leadership.

!!️ To my friends at Edwards AFB and the 419th Flight Test Squadron, keep leading well and please take care of yourselves and one another. I'm here if you need me.

“The men and women who serve our nation deserve structurally sound airfields, command centers, hardened shelters and facilities they can depend on. We can only guarantee such readiness by ensuring that the foundations of our military strength are forged right here at home.”

"All of this sounds like fantasy, and likely it is. Yet, when I don my spectacles of positivity and embrace a maximalist view of the first paragraph of the MOU, then I can start to see something that would actually warrant hope, praise, and adulation. Anything short of that, however, provides a severe reason for concern that nothing has changed and Iran’s world-renowned negotiating skills have turned their military defeat into a strategic win for them and them alone."

!?️ In your sphere of influence and realm of impact, what is hidden beyond the horizon? What great land beyond your view is unknown and uncertain.

📣 We are massively out of practice!

🚛 We haven’t moved in six years. It was June of 2020 when my family moved from California to Maryland – I was in Iraq at the time and they did it without me in the midst of COVID.

🔥 That’s a long hiatus for a military family that had been used to several moves during such a span. It is one of those cultural elements of military life that most people can’t understand.

🍦 By the way, it is time to bust out that ice cream maker!
|
---
☕ The power of a local coffee shop!

🚛 Now that we’ve moved, it’s time to find a new local coffee shop. Any recommendations❓

🫶 We have loved Kozy Beans! It provided the perfect locale to connect – it was my go-to location for meetings and chats for the last several years. And the coffee was great! I always shudder when I see the long lines at the massive chains. Those people are missing out on better coffee and the best community!

I’m sure that the people next to me thought I was nuts, and if you want to be considered similarly strange then read this in public. If not, read it in private. Whether it is a survivor from a bloody battle, or a spouse back home dealing with loss, none consider what they have done anything other than ordinary. That is true of everyone in this book. They don’t believe they deserve to be called heroes. Perhaps there is a lesson in that. The one sure way to spot a hero may be to look for the ones who insist they are not.”

clean_body: We need to demonstrate strength of capability and will | | | | | | | | Teichert in the Trenches - July 2026 Welcome to this month’s installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs. And of course, Happy 250th Birthday America! Teichert in the News Here are a few interviews during the last month where I express concern about how our operational and tactical wins in Iran have not yielded strategic success. As always, you can watch a more extensive range of hits on my YouTube page. | | | | 🇺🇲 🇮🇱 🇮🇷 We need to demonstrate strength of capability and will (June 8). 💥 Thanks to John Roberts, Special Report, and Fox News for the opportunity to join a panel with Brit Hume and Gillian Turner to talk about the latest regarding Iran. | | | | 🇮🇷 We can expect the Iranian snake to keep biting. 🇺🇸 🇮🇱 🎥 Thanks to John Roberts and Fox News for another opportunity to express my concerns about the current Iranian deal (June 19) | 🇺🇸 🇮🇱 🇮🇷 Are we leaving Iran strong and emboldened !?️ 🎥 Thanks to Leland Vittert and NewsNation (June 17) for this telling interview about the current state of the Iran deal that expresses concerns ten weeks after the cease fire that matched some of my original concerns (see below from April 7 for my immediate thoughts while the cease fire was being announced). | | | | Thoughts by Teichert | | | | 🎉 Adding a bit of personal joy! ✈️ In the new Southwest Airlines process, certain seats get an upgraded snack (a green bag of pistachios). I’m not quite sure what you have to do to earn this bonus treat, but I guess I’m not doing it. So, I treat myself! 🥜 I have a stash of these green pistachio bags at home. Any time I’m traveling on Southwest, I bring enough in my carry-on to eat on every leg. And, after the flight attendant hands out the normal snacks, I pull out my own upgrade. It provides a small dose of joy each time. 😆 A measure of bonus amusement – the flight attendants almost always do a double take as they walk by my seat and see that green bag. They must be thinking to themselves – “That guy doesn’t deserve a special snack! Did I accidently give him one?” !?️ How do you give yourself a small dose of joy and measure of bonus amusement?! | | | | 📣 The very real burdens of leadership❗ 💔 This month’s news of the B-52 flight test crash at Edwards Air Force Base was heart breaking and gut wrenching. With waves of messages out there expressing sympathy and hazarding guesses as to the root cause, I didn’t want to pile on. Instead, I wanted to add something different – because I’ve been there as a leader. ☑️ There are a million things to do during a tragedy for leaders at all levels. Even days later, the pace and the emotional toll remain relentless for those who have been carrying the burden for others. 😢 During the F-22 flight test crash and the loss of Dave “Cools” Cooley in March of 2009, it was a grueling time that I still vividly remember today. As I was leading and serving at that time, two days into the response I hadn’t even had the time or the energy to shed a tear. The next day I was in the shower when an emotional wave hit me as I started to sob uncontrollably. It was a moment of unguarded pause that allowed me to start processing the events of that week. ✈️ As you reflect on the tragedy in the Mojave Desert, pray for those leaders who are shouldering that unbearable burden. And leaders everywhere, honestly assess your readiness to carry the same. 🎤 With that being said, times like these are the best times to be a leader if you’re doing it right. Not because they are fun ... they are NOT! ... but because they are meaningful, because they are life changing, because they are impactful, because they are consequential, and because they require the height of humanity and the essence of leadership. !!️ To my friends at Edwards AFB and the 419th Flight Test Squadron, keep leading well and please take care of yourselves and one another. I'm here if you need me. | | | | Thanks to Real Clear Politics for publishing these thoughts on the national security implications of cryptocurrency policy (June 18) 📣 “Stories of ghost fleets and Iranian blackmail in the Strait of Hormuz have been flashing across our screens and populating our feeds as a dominant story in 2026. They are textbook examples of devilishly designed sanction-evasion networks to finance illicit activity and transport dirty capital. These international stories provide the perfect baseline upon which to judge the shape and structure of properly designed cryptocurrency and digital asset legislation.” | | | | I appreciate NewsNation publishing these thoughts about America’s foundational industrial capacity (June 19). “Strong military infrastructure is what allows the U.S. to project power, deter adversaries and bring our men and women in uniform home safely. Right now, that infrastructure is at risk in ways Washington has been slow to recognize.” “The men and women who serve our nation deserve structurally sound airfields, command centers, hardened shelters and facilities they can depend on. We can only guarantee such readiness by ensuring that the foundations of our military strength are forged right here at home.” | Thank you to The Family Research Council for publishing this optimistic view of the Iran deal – though it probably could have been entitled: “If these things aren’t true, then it’s a really bad deal.” (June 22) "All of this sounds like fantasy, and likely it is. Yet, when I don my spectacles of positivity and embrace a maximalist view of the first paragraph of the MOU, then I can start to see something that would actually warrant hope, praise, and adulation. Anything short of that, however, provides a severe reason for concern that nothing has changed and Iran’s world-renowned negotiating skills have turned their military defeat into a strategic win for them and them alone." | 🇵🇹 The end of the old world. 🇺🇲 Before the discovery of the new world, this point to the northwest of Lisbon was the edge of planet earth. The great land beyond the sea was unknown and uncertain. !?️ In your sphere of influence and realm of impact, what is hidden beyond the horizon? What great land beyond your view is unknown and uncertain. 📷 Please see below for a great picture of Porto (our Uber driver called anything south of the Douro River Morocco based on the northern limits of the conquest of the Moors) and one of Melonie and I enjoying the Portugal soccer victory on TV with a bunch of enthusiastic fans during our quick trip. | | Teichert in the Trenches | | | | | | | | Behind the Scenes | | | | 📣 We are massively out of practice! 🚛 We haven’t moved in six years. It was June of 2020 when my family moved from California to Maryland – I was in Iraq at the time and they did it without me in the midst of COVID. 🔥 That’s a long hiatus for a military family that had been used to several moves during such a span. It is one of those cultural elements of military life that most people can’t understand. 🍦 By the way, it is time to bust out that ice cream maker! | ☕ The power of a local coffee shop! 🚛 Now that we’ve moved, it’s time to find a new local coffee shop. Any recommendations❓ 🫶 We have loved Kozy Beans! It provided the perfect locale to connect – it was my go-to location for meetings and chats for the last several years. And the coffee was great! I always shudder when I see the long lines at the massive chains. Those people are missing out on better coffee and the best community! | | | | If you are wondering where to find me in the next several months, I’ll be on the back deck of our new home in Annapolis! My Bookshelf | | | | This book made me laugh out loud and cry tears of hilarity on two separate airplane flights. I’m sure that the people next to me thought I was nuts, and if you want to be considered similarly strange then read this in public. If not, read it in private. Either way, you’ll love it – especially if you’re a dad and can see yourself in such unbelievable and retroactively amusing situations. | | | | “That is a sentiment I have heard often during my decades covering the remarkable 9/11 generation of warriors and their families. Whether it is a survivor from a bloody battle, or a spouse back home dealing with loss, none consider what they have done anything other than ordinary. That is true of everyone in this book. They don’t believe they deserve to be called heroes. Perhaps there is a lesson in that. The one sure way to spot a hero may be to look for the ones who insist they are not.” | “Although Williams’ principal concern in the separation of church and state was to preserve the church from worldly contamination, he also believed that government suffered when diverted from its proper functions by the church ... Whether pagan or Christian, so long as a government protected the people who created it, in their persons and in their property, it did what a government ought to do. But when it tried to save souls, it succeeded only in injuring bodies; when it tried to protect the true church, it succeeded only in transforming true into false.” PLUS Posts for the Month | | | | | | | | | | Blast from the P ast | | | | I’ve always had a great love of the USA! My Air Force ROTC unit didn’t appreciate it as much as everyone else did! | In June 2018, we took an amazing two-week trip to Costa Rica. This is a Teichert girl original from that memorable family vacation! I’ll be a leadership keynote speaker at the Encounter Young Adult Conference in Orlando (July 23-24). I’ll be signing books at EAA’s Author’s Corner (Oshkosh, WI, July 25). body:
#

Team —
Once again, the Trump Administration is trying to make it easier for those who should not have guns, to get guns — this time, delivered right to their door.
In April, the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosions (ATF) released a number of rules, including one that would allow people to purchase guns over the internet, without any in-person interaction with the gun dealer.
Yes, really.
While federal law requires all sales to comply with background check requirements, this rule would look to blow a giant hole in this standard safety measure, allowing gun stores to use virtual, untested, processes.
**Additionally, people who may be in a moment of despair, with thoughts to hurt either themselves, or others, could order a gun and have it delivered to their home the next day.**
This rule goes beyond partisan politics. Allowing someone to order a gun, as easily as they order groceries, is dangerous, unnecessary, and will lead to more deaths. But there is still time to act.
It’s important that the ATF hears from you. We need 1,000 people today to send a comment to the agency to let them know Americans oppose the rule: “Revising Non-Over-the-Counter Firearms Transaction Requirements.” In order for each comment to count and be heard, it’s important that you tell your reason for opposing this dangerous proposed rule.
**[Submit your comments by clicking here:](https://go.giffords.org/go/68408?t=1&akid=11601%2E3935704%2ESPz8TU)**
**[SUBMIT MY COMMENTS](https://go.giffords.org/go/68408?t=2&akid=11601%2E3935704%2ESPz8TU)**
Below is sample language you can also copy-paste:
My name is [NAME], and I am writing to OPPOSE the “Revising Non-Over-the-Counter Firearms Transaction Requirements” rule proposed by the ATF.
This rule is a dangerous step towards allowing access to guns to those who should not have them, including criminals, traffickers and underage children. It is unnecessary and will weaken background checks systems while putting our communities in danger.
[Insert 1-2 sentences here about your opposition to the rule].
**[SUBMIT MY COMMENTS](https://go.giffords.org/go/68408?t=3&akid=11601%2E3935704%2ESPz8TU)**
Thank you for speaking out.
GIFFORDS
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260702-1-b&t=4&akid=11601%2E3935704%2ESPz8TU)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=11601%2E3935704%2ESPz8TU) if you'd like to unsubscribe. body:
How real investigative journalism died, and who's bringing it back.
How real investigative journalism died — and who's bringing it back.
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e826616/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvVVRKQngyYlhZMw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDI/LbmNsN3laU3JXTA/qP2hpZHM9bmN6MUJ0bG9rRjV5dlBscw/gakZoLg/s5of08d772b)

| [ ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Dear Friend,
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)In 1887, a young reporter named Nellie Bly did something no one else would. **She faked insanity** , got herself committed to a notorious asylum, and lived as a patient for ten days so she could document — from the inside — how the helpless were really being treated. Her reporting stunned the country and forced real reform. That's where investigative journalism comes from. Not a press release. Not a podium. A person willing to go inside, at real personal risk, and come back with the truth. [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[FUND THE WORK NO ONE ELSE WILL DO — DONATE NOW →](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** A few years later, Upton Sinclair went undercover in the meatpacking plants and wrote what he saw. The outcry was so fierce it produced the nation's first food-safety laws — the reason you can trust what's on your dinner table tonight. Ida Tarbell took on the most powerful monopoly on earth and won. Two young reporters followed a "third-rate burglary**" all the way to a president's resignation.** For a century, this is what the press did. It comforted the afflicted and afflicted the comfortable. The powerful went to bed afraid that somewhere, a reporter was working. That fear is what kept them honest. **That fear is what a free country runs on.** Now look around. The outlets that once did this work have become the very institutions they were supposed to watch. They lunch with the powerful instead of investigating them. They print what they're handed. They turned in their Pentagon press badges rather than sign a pledge they didn't like — while we picked ours up and walked in to ask the questions they won't. When was the last time anyone in power lost a single night of sleep over a legacy newspaper reporter? [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[FUND THE WORK NO ONE ELSE WILL DO — DONATE NOW →](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** **The watchdog became a lapdog**. And a republic without a watchdog is just a playground for whoever is most willing to lie. That's the gap we exist to fill. When my journalist spends eight months living inside an extremist network, or I sit on a Skid Row sidewalk in disguise, or we put a hidden camera in front of an official lying to your face — that's not a stunt. **It's the oldest and most honorable tradition in American journalism, the one everyone else abandoned.** I didn't invent this. I'm just one of the last people still doing it. And whether it survives into the next generation doesn't depend on me. [**It depends on whether enough Americans decide it's worth paying for.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Nellie Bly had a newspaper behind her. Upton Sinclair had publishers. I have you. That's the entire model — no corporate owners, no government money, just citizens who still believe the powerful should be afraid of getting caught. [**Will you help keep that tradition alive?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
In Truth,James O'Keefe Founder, O'Keefe Media Group
P.S. ****Every great muckraker in history needed someone to fund the work while they went inside. Today, that someone is you.[**Pick up the torch — donate now.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

108 S Washington St. Suite 200
Alexandria, VA 22314

body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

BREAKING: Congress just blocked an amendment that would have stopped a
dangerous escalation in U.S.-Israeli military ties, all but fusing the two
militaries.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39140?source=email-20260702&t=1011&akid=10985%2E5885482%2Ezz0jHr ]Headline: Congress blocks Massie-Khanna effort to kill US-Israel
integration

Behind closed doors, a committee just stopped the House from even DEBATING
a measure that would have prevented a provision known as Section 219
(formerly 224) from being jammed into the must-pass National Defense
Authorization Act. It would HARDWIRE U.S. military support to Israel,
tying the Pentagon and U.S. weapons industry even more tightly to the
Netanyahu government.

The good news is the Senate still has a chance to drop this dangerous
provision and Bernie is leading the charge. Final negotiations are coming,
but the only way to win is if thousands of us speak out immediately and
demand that Congress stop Section 219 from becoming law.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39140?source=email-20260702&t=1012&akid=10985%2E5885482%2Ezz0jHr ]Add your name now: Tell Congress to strip Section 219 from the NDAA
before it’s too late!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39140?source=email-20260702&t=1013&akid=10985%2E5885482%2Ezz0jHr ]ADD YOUR NAME

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39140?source=email-20260702&t=1014&akid=10985%2E5885482%2Ezz0jHr ]Bernie tweet: Netanyahu is lobbying for Section 224 in the national
defense bill, a provision that quietly expands US-Israel military
cooperation and weapons development with almost zero oversight. The
American people do not want more US military aid to Israel. We must defeat
Section 224.

Section 219 was written by lobbyists and Netanyahu himself. The merger
would supersize weapons deals, surveillance tech, and intelligence sharing
for years to come, no matter what voters might want. It would strip away
even the limited Congressional checks that exist today, making the
U.S.-Israel military partnership more secretive, less accountable, and
even harder for the public – or even Congress itself – to monitor.

It comes as a growing majority of Americans oppose unconditional support
for the Israeli government in the midst of mass violence. That’s why a
bipartisan group of leaders tried to stop the proposed US/Israel military
merger with an amendment. Then, the House Rules Committee shut it down,
preventing a full vote.

The stakes couldn’t be higher. Netanyahu’s government is openly saying
"all of Lebanon must burn", while escalating violence in Gaza and the West
Bank. Not one dime of our money should go to enable collective punishment,
targeting of civilians, or expansion of illegal settlements. Congress must
not entangle us deeper in endless war.

We’ve seen what happens when public outcry is loud and clear, but time is
running out.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39140?source=email-20260702&t=1015&akid=10985%2E5885482%2Ezz0jHr ]Take action now. Add your name to send a loud, unified message: No more
blank checks for endless wars, no secret deals, and no more complicity in
oppression. Section 219 must go.

name: The DNC
subject: BIG week for the DNC’s Legal Team
body:
Here's the scoop:
---

As the memorandum of understanding between the Trump administration and Iran remains on shaky terrain, Israel has made clear it intends to keep its forces entrenched in Lebanon for the foreseeable future. Iran has said that a refusal on the part of President Donald Trump to force Israel to end its war on Hezbollah and southern Lebanon would cross a red line that could jeopardize a potential nuclear deal.
Despite Tehran's warnings, Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have moved forward with a plan to exclude Hezbollah from the Iran deal and they succeeded in enlisting the Lebanese government in their campaign. Iran has maintained it will not tolerate a continuation of the war in Lebanon, but how Tehran will respond remains an open question.
It has been more than 120 days since the war against Iran began with the assassination of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. What Trump initially proclaimed as a regime change war that would quickly pave the way for a domestic uprising soon transformed into a quagmire. Iran responded to the U.S. and Israeli war with sustained retaliatory strikes, primarily targeting U.S. military infrastructure in the region and causing an unprecedented evacuation of bases. Tehran also pummeled Israel with nightly barrages of ballistic missiles and drones. Combined with its moves to assert dominance over the strategic Strait of Hormuz, Iran amassed significant leverage as the U.S. began seeking an offramp to the war.
In mid-June, the U.S. and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding that was formally intended to bring a halt to the war and open a path for negotiations on a range of issues, including the future of Iran's nuclear program. Tehran, however, made clear that it would not proceed toward any long-term deal unless the U.S. compelled Israel to end its war against Lebanon. Since the signing of the MOU, Netanyahu has maneuvered to ensure Israeli forces can remain entrenched in Lebanon, working with the Trump administration to delink Hezbollah from the Iran deal. Hezbollah formally entered the war on March 2 and Iran has insisted that the ceasefire must apply not only to Iran, but to southern Lebanon as well. Israel and the U.S., however, embarked on an alternative path aimed at enlisting the Lebanese government of President Joseph Aoun as their local partner in a campaign aimed at disarming and dismantling Hezbollah.
A subsequent "framework," signed on June 26, between Israel and Lebanon appears to have succeeded in laying the foundations for that effort. The text of the agreement portrays Hezbollah as an illegal insurgent movement and enables Israeli forces to remain indefinitely in Lebanon until Lebanese Armed Forces enact the "successful disarmament of non-state armed groups and dismantlement of their infrastructure." Only after this is accomplished would Israeli occupation forces "progressively redeploy out of the Lebanese territory."
As the U.S. and Iran continue indirect technical talks, there are mounting concerns in Tehran that Trump is simply using the negotiations to prepare for a resumption of the war. Tehran has also said that it will not stand idly by as Israel continues its attacks on Lebanon, pointing out that the MOU explicitly commits the U.S. to end the war.
Drop Site's Jeremy Scahill spoke with Amal Saad, a lecturer on international relations and politics at Cardiff University in the UK who is writing a book on Hezbollah and the Axis of Resistance. In a wide-ranging discussion, Saad offers a comprehensive analysis of the U.S.-Israeli campaign to co-opt the Lebanese government into the war against Hezbollah.
"It's a form of self-colonization," Saad said, referring to the recent agreement between Lebanon and Israel. "It's effectively handing over south Lebanon for Israel to colonize, handing over the people of the south for Israel to genocide and ethnically cleanse. And in exchange, this government will offer civil strife, knowing that even with the civil strife, they probably will still not succeed in disarming Hezbollah."
Saad argues that while Israel's aim is to spark a civil war in Lebanon, Iran has indicated it is fully committed to confronting the Israeli occupation. How Iran responds to the U.S.-Israeli maneuvers will have a significant impact on Lebanon's future.
"Iran is very clearly now arising--it is by far now the strongest regional power. And Hezbollah has also proven that it is much more powerful and definitely not finished, as many had predicted it had been since November 2024. So this agreement does not reflect the political reality on the ground," Saad said. "We need to wait to see what Iran is going to do next. I think that's what Hezbollah is sort of banking on--that Iran will not tolerate this for much longer, perhaps even responding with kinetic strikes against Israel."
Saad and Scahill also discuss Iran's regional and global position in the post-October 7 world and Saad explains why she believes another regional war is inevitable.

If our work matters to you, As the memorandum of understanding between the Trump administration and Iran remains on shaky terrain, Israel has made clear it intends to keep its forces entrenched in Lebanon for the foreseeable future. Iran has said that a refusal on the part of President Donald Trump to force Israel to end its war on Hezbollah and southern Lebanon would cross a red line that could jeopardize a potential nuclear deal. Despite Tehran's warnings, Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have moved forward with a plan to exclude Hezbollah from the Iran deal and they succeeded in enlisting the Lebanese government in their campaign. Iran has maintained it will not tolerate a continuation of the war in Lebanon, but how Tehran will respond remains an open question. It has been more than 120 days since the war against Iran began with the assassination of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. What Trump initially proclaimed as a regime change war that would quickly pave the way for a domestic uprising soon transformed into a quagmire. Iran responded to the U.S. and Israeli war with sustained retaliatory strikes, primarily targeting U.S. military infrastructure in the region and causing an unprecedented evacuation of bases. Tehran also pummeled Israel with nightly barrages of ballistic missiles and drones. Combined with its moves to assert dominance over the strategic Strait of Hormuz, Iran amassed significant leverage as the U.S. began seeking an offramp to the war. In mid-June, the U.S. and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding that was formally intended to bring a halt to the war and open a path for negotiations on a range of issues, including the future of Iran's nuclear program. Tehran, however, made clear that it would not proceed toward any long-term deal unless the U.S. compelled Israel to end its war against Lebanon. Since the signing of the MOU, Netanyahu has maneuvered to ensure Israeli forces can remain entrenched in Lebanon, working with the Trump administration to delink Hezbollah from the Iran deal. Hezbollah formally entered the war on March 2 and Iran has insisted that the ceasefire must apply not only to Iran, but to southern Lebanon as well. Israel and the U.S., however, embarked on an alternative path aimed at enlisting the Lebanese government of President Joseph Aoun as their local partner in a campaign aimed at disarming and dismantling Hezbollah. A subsequent "framework," signed on June 26, between Israel and Lebanon appears to have succeeded in laying the foundations for that effort. The text of the agreement portrays Hezbollah as an illegal insurgent movement and enables Israeli forces to remain indefinitely in Lebanon until Lebanese Armed Forces enact the "successful disarmament of non-state armed groups and dismantlement of their infrastructure." Only after this is accomplished would Israeli occupation forces "progressively redeploy out of the Lebanese territory." As the U.S. and Iran continue indirect technical talks, there are mounting concerns in Tehran that Trump is simply using the negotiations to prepare for a resumption of the war. Tehran has also said that it will not stand idly by as Israel continues its attacks on Lebanon, pointing out that the MOU explicitly commits the U.S. to end the war. Drop Site's Jeremy Scahill spoke with Amal Saad, a lecturer on international relations and politics at Cardiff University in the UK who is writing a book on Hezbollah and the Axis of Resistance. In a wide-ranging discussion, Saad offers a comprehensive analysis of the U.S.-Israeli campaign to co-opt the Lebanese government into the war against Hezbollah. "It's a form of self-colonization," Saad said, referring to the recent agreement between Lebanon and Israel. "It's effectively handing over south Lebanon for Israel to colonize, handing over the people of the south for Israel to genocide and ethnically cleanse. And in exchange, this government will offer civil strife, knowing that even with the civil strife, they probably will still not succeed in disarming Hezbollah." Saad argues that while Israel's aim is to spark a civil war in Lebanon, Iran has indicated it is fully committed to confronting the Israeli occupation. How Iran responds to the U.S.-Israeli maneuvers will have a significant impact on Lebanon's future. "Iran is very clearly now arising--it is by far now the strongest regional power. And Hezbollah has also proven that it is much more powerful and definitely not finished, as many had predicted it had been since November 2024. So this agreement does not reflect the political reality on the ground," Saad said. "We need to wait to see what Iran is going to do next. I think that's what Hezbollah is sort of banking on--that Iran will not tolerate this for much longer, perhaps even responding with kinetic strikes against Israel." Saad and Scahill also discuss Iran's regional and global position in the post-October 7 world and Saad explains why she believes another regional war is inevitable. body:
| Hi friend, **I just wanted to say thank you.** We’ve closed the books on our Q2 fundraising. As we prepare our public FEC report, we're feeling ready for the fight ahead. Without your help, we couldn't have reached our goal — one that's critical to defending this seat and sending a strong message: **OH-01 refuses to let wealthy interests gerrymander and buy their way into this seat.** This feels especially timely as we approach the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence. This nation was founded on the principle that all people have inherent, inalienable rights, including the right to "Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness." These are the values that our government has a duty and responsibility to uphold. That's the kind of leadership I believe in: one grounded in empathy, fairness, and the conviction that we all do better when we all belong. Whether it's lowering healthcare costs, protecting the freedom to vote, or rooting out corruption, I'm fighting to make government work for the people it's meant to serve. So, thank you from the bottom of my heart. Peace and Love 🙏💙,
Greg Landsman

# **Poll: One-third of Democrats favorable toward Democratic Socialists**
A new **[Pew Research survey finds 32% of Democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/9e24fd2e-27bd-4e70-a80c-5919688d3604?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** view democratic socialist politicians favorably, compared to just 11% who view them unfavorably and 56% who are indifferent. Support is highest among self-described liberal Democrats at 52%, while moderate and conservative Democrats are more evenly split, with slightly more expressing disapproval than approval.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9e24fd2e-27bd-4e70-a80c-5919688d3604?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The demographic breakdown reveals a notable irony:** democratic socialist support within the party is strongest among white, college-educated, upper-income Democrats -- the very groups the movement claims to oppose. White Democrats support the socialist wing at nearly double the rate of Black and Hispanic Democrats, and upper-income Democrats outpace low-income Democrats by 16 points.
* **The broader American public remains skeptical,** with 38% of all Americans viewing democratic socialist politicians unfavorably versus 15% favorably. Republican disapproval reaches 69%. The poll comes as more than three dozen DSA-backed candidates have won Democratic primaries nationwide this cycle.

# **Gavin Newsom defies SCOTUS ruling on trans athletes in women 's sports**
California's governor's office said Tuesday's Supreme Court ruling upholding state bans on biological male transgender athletes in women's sports **[will have no effect](https://substack.com/redirect/a3670a65-4c39-4184-8bf2-e2547fe41b61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on California, which has permitted transgender students to compete consistent with their gender identity since 2013. The state remains one of 23 without protections for women's sports and has no plans to change course.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a3670a65-4c39-4184-8bf2-e2547fe41b61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The ruling intensifies scrutiny on California,** which has faced repeated national controversy over transgender athlete AB Hernandez winning girls' track and field state titles two consecutive years. The Trump DOJ has an active Title IX lawsuit against California education agencies over the policy, launched after Hernandez's victories last year.
* **Newsom himself has privately acknowledged the issue 's political complexity, **previously calling male competition in girls' sports "deeply unfair" and describing frustration from progressive parents at his children's soccer games -- while his administration publicly continues defending existing state policy.

### When the base gets louder, the party has to stop changing the channel
| | [Harry Dunn](https://substack.com/@harrydunn)
---
| Jul 2
---
| [](https://substack.com/@harrydunn)
---

---

When I stood on the West Front of the Capitol on January 6th, I wasn't thinking about "factions" within a party, internal polling or donors. I was thinking about my duty to the people inside that building, to the nation and to the Constitution that keeps us all free"ish". Since then, I've traded my badge for an ACTBLUE account, and I've spent a lot of time traveling across the country talking to folks who feel like the political system has left them behind. What I'm seeing lately in our Democratic primaries this season, tells me one thing loud and clear... the heartbeat of this party is changing, and we need to pay attention.
The recent primary [win](https://substack.com/redirect/1196e61d-89c0-473d-989c-c54ae2b7202a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Democratic Socialists like Melat Kiros's historic victory in Colorado are more than just headlines. They are proof that the status quo isn't just being questioned; it's being rejected by people who are tired of waiting for "someday" to come. These wins show a growing hunger for bold action and ideas. When an incumbent who has been in office for a decade or two or hell even three, loses to a newcomer with a democratic socialist platform, it's a signal that the old way of doing business isn't cutting it for the person working two jobs just to keep the lights on.
Then comes this, one of the loudest messages I've heard on the campaign trail is a resounding, burning disdain for the way special interest groups have been buying our elections. Voters are tired of seeing their voices drowned out by "dark money" and corporate PACs. We have to be honest with ourselves, many in our own party have and continue to benefit from this system, but that doesn't mean we should justify it when it takes power from the people and gives it to corporations and "dark money" donors who could care less about us. To truly be the party of the people, we must stand together to reject the influence of big money and commit to passing laws that limit it. A vote shouldn't be something you can put a price tag on.
But I've also been around long enough to know that a few wins doesn't mean the debate is over. We've seen other races where progressive or democratic socialist challengers didn't cross the finish line, falling to candidates who lean more toward the center or moderates. We shouldn't look at these losses as failures of a movement, but rather as a reminder that our party is as diverse as the country itself. We shouldn't get so consumed with crowning one side the "wave of the future" that we stop listening to the voters who aren't there yet. The real win isn't just a specific candidate taking a seat, it's the Democratic Party is actually forced to listen to a wider range of its own people and what keeps them up at night.
Even a small portion of this party is still part of this party. Think of it like a friendship or a marriage; if one person stops feeling seen or heard, they don't just sit there forever. They start looking for love in other places. We get defections when people feel like their voices are being silenced or their struggles are being treated as footnotes. We love to call ourselves the "Big Tent Party," but you can't have a "members only" section inside that tent. If we want to keep everyone under one roof, we have to make sure everyone feels like they have a seat at the table.
Our strength is in our unity, and we need that strength now more than ever. We are facing a Trump administration that has shown a total disregard for the guardrails of our democracy. My goal and I hope it is all of ours, is to get the majority back in Congress. We need that majority to hold this administration accountable to the law and to ensure that what I saw happen at the Capitol on January 6th and every day after, never happens again. We can't do that if we're busy tearing each other down over who is the most Democratic. We need every vote, from the moderate in the suburbs to the democratic socialist in the city.
At the end of the day, people are looking for a break. They're looking at their grocery receipts, their rent increases, and their healthcare premiums, and they're asking who is going to make their lives easier. Whether we agree on every policy or not, we all want to lower costs for everyday Americans. We want a country where you don't have to go into debt just to stay healthy or get an education. That's the common ground that wins elections.
I spent over fifteen years protecting the Capitol, and I've seen what happens when we lose our way. We win when we stand together. Let's celebrate the new energy in our party, learn from the losses, and keep our eyes on the mission: protecting our democracy and delivering for the people who sent us there. It's time to hold the line, together.

subject: MAGA's flat out lies

body:
Opponents of voting rights lack the common sense to understand that these anti-voting conspiracy theories are just flat-out lies. They'd rather see a vast web of shadowy interests arrayed against them than reexamine their own values when they lose elections.
That's why they create bills like the SAVE America, SAVE, and MEGA Acts, to strip our fundamental right to vote until only their select few have the privilege to vote.
Step up with $35 or more right now to stop the SAVE Act and defend our right to vote from these vicious attacks >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070226_1&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070226_1&amount=25]
President Trump used his recent State of the Union address and the DHS funding debate to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070226_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE AMERICA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070226_1&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070226_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070226_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070226_1&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070226_1&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070226_1&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070226_1&amount=35]
How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070226_1&amount=35]

subject: Real patriotism looks like this
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSM01/1/118960/images/VRF_Fireworks-removebg-preview.png] https://va4reprofreedom.org/ [https://va4reprofreedom.org/] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSM01/1/118960/images/fireworks%20flip.png]
Friend, as you gather with family and friends this Fourth of July to celebrate America’s 250th anniversary, I hope you’ll take a moment to reflect on this incredible milestone for our country.
For 250 years, generations of Americans have fought tooth-and-nail to build a nation that more fully delivers on the promise of freedom and personal liberty. While this anniversary is a cause for celebration, it’s also a powerful reminder that freedom is never guaranteed .
Today, Virginians for Reproductive Freedom is taking up the mantle of freedom by rallying all Virginians to vote “YES” on November 3 to ENSHRINE reproductive freedom into our state’s constitution.
And as we head into the heart of the summer, we’d love for you to be a part of our historic movement!
LEARN MORE [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]
We’re fighting for a future where every person has the right to reproductive health care and every family has the opportunity to thrive.
In honor of the Fourth, be a part of our nation’s extraordinary legacy of freedom by doing one or all of these four things:
1. Find out what’s at stake on November 3. [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]
2. Add your name to the Virginians for Reproductive Freedom scrapbook. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
3. Share your story [https://secure.ngpvan.com/wwJ0emjqoUaCu-Wfjn11Hg2] to help show why reproductive freedom matters and why protecting these rights is so urgent.
4. Chip in a contribution to support our fight for reproductive freedom [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=070226]
This holiday weekend, while we celebrate the freedom won by those who came before us, let’s also remember the responsibility we have to fight for a better future for the next generation.
In gratitude,
Han Jones
Campaign Manager
P.S. Real patriotism looks like fighting for freedom! Help us defend Virginians’ access to reproductive health care for generations to come by chipping in a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em]
Visit our website [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]
Virginians for Reproductive Freedom
600 Pennsylvania Ave SE Unit 15845
Washington, DC 20003

Dear Peter,
For the first time ever, the Republican Party will hold a Midterm Convention -- a historic, one-of-a-kind event. President Donald J. Trump, Vice President J.D. Vance, the Republican National Committee and Republicans from around the country will come together in Dallas for a national celebration heading into the 2026 midterms -- a moment to unite our Party, energize our grassroots, and showcase our candidates on the national stage, all while celebrating our nation, our achievements, and our bright future.
"We are going to celebrate the GREAT AMERICAN COMEBACK, and the incredible successes of the American People who transformed our Country through the America First Agenda. . . . It will be a RALLY like none other!" - President Donald J. Trump
If you're even considering going, apply to join the Massachuestts delegation right away. More information below.
To Victory in November!
---
|
---
Amy Carnevale Chair, Massachusetts Republican Party
---
The Great American Comeback Midterm Convention September 9-10, 2026 | American Airlines Center | Dallas, Texas

## What We're Celebrating
* The America First Agenda: No tax on tips, no tax on overtime, no tax on Social Security, stronger borders, the safest communities in our history, lower costs, and real affordability for American families.
* More jobs, American energy dominance, and the hardworking Americans, innovators, entrepreneurs, manufacturers, first responders, and job creators powering our nation's Golden Age.
* America's 250th Birthday -- together, we are building the foundation for the next 250 years of American Greatness.

## What This Event Is
* A special ceremonial national gathering -- not a nominating convention.
* A celebration of our Party's vision and candidates, built to mobilize voters ahead of November.

## Key Distinctions from Conventions
* No nominating delegates. There is no credentialing process, as this is not a delegate or alternate event associated with a nomination.
* Tickets, not credentials. Each state party will receive and distribute a set allocation of tickets. The MassGOP will accept applications for tickets and applicants are subject to vetting at both the state and national level.

## Logistics at a Glance
* Dates: Wednesday, September 9 - Thursday, September 10, 2026
* Venue: American Airlines Center, 2500 Victory Ave, Dallas, TX 75219
* Ticket allocations: The allocation process will move quickly. There is a $20 processing fee per application.
* Dues: If selected, you must pay your dues within 48 hours, which are expected to increase from the 2024 Convention Dues of $500.
* Hotels: The MassGOP will reserve an allocation of hotel rooms for ticket holders once the official hotels are released by the RNC.
* Transportation: Transportation to and from Dallas will be on your own. Transportation to and from the RNC hotels to the American Airlines Center will be provided to all official ticket holders.
* Overall Costs: Upwards of $3,000
