Security magnetometers open at 1:00 PM on Saturday, July 4, 2026. Please note that guest entry will be closed at 6pm. Plan to arrive early—with large crowds expected, attendees' queues will be significant. Metro and rideshare are strongly recommended; driving and parking in the immediate area is first-come, first-served. The public area on the mall is also first-come, first-served. Additionally, guests are only permitted one clear bag, and no coolers, chairs, glass or thermal containers will be allowed. It will be in the 100 degree range in the afternoon and carrying ability for food and water will be limited, so please plan accordingly. Extreme Heat Advisory Prince William County is under an Extreme Heat Warning through Saturday, July 5th, with the potential for a heat index at 112 degrees. Temperatures that high can be dangerous, especially to senior citizens. I strongly urge you to exercise caution during these very hot days. Make sure to stay hydrated, avoid alcohol and caffeine if you’re going to be in the heat for prolonged periods of time, and avoid excessive physical exertion outside when possible, especially in the middle of the day. During periods of extreme heat, risk of heat exhaustion and heat illness go up dramatically. Symptoms to watch out for include: Heat Exhaustion: Heavy sweating, paleness, muscle cramps, tiredness, weakness, dizziness, headaches, nausea, and fainting. If not treated, the victim's condition will worsen. Heat Stroke:**** Extremely high body temperature above 103°F, hot dry red skin, rapid strong pulse, headache, dizziness, nausea, confusion, unconsciousness. If you encounter someone with the symptoms, call 911 immediately and move the victim to a cool area but do not give them liquids to drink. All Prince William County public libraries serve as cooling shelters during these heat emergency events. The county has additional details and resources for staying safe this week,** As always, please do not hesitate to reach out to my office to share your views, ideas for a bill, or for help with a state agency. Have a safe and festive Independence Day weekend! | In Service, | | The Honorable Briana D. Sewell \-- 25th House District DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov from future updates

Dear Friend, Nearly 250 years ago, ordinary men did something extraordinary. America's Founders pledged "our Lives, our Fortunes and our sacred Honor" to establish a nation where freedom could flourish—not only for themselves, but for generations they would never live to see. They believed liberty was a gift worth sacrificing for. They dreamed of the day freedom would ring across a new nation—and long after they were gone. They understood something we often forget: A nation's future is determined by what one generation passes to the next. As America prepares to celebrate its 250th birthday, that responsibility now belongs to us. Every Independence Day, we hear the words, **"Let freedom ring."**
---
**[But if freedom is to ring for another 250 years, it must first take root in the hearts of our children.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e13703733/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9icmF2ZS1mb3ItZ29vZC9zdGFyNDlhNDgyLTI2NjMtNGViMC04MmY1LTZlMjU3MjJkMWNiNi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDI/LbmNsQjcwSTBsRA/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMyMzNfd3Ix/gakbnLA/sco7ee5e479)** The greatest way we can honor the sacrifice of our Founders isn't simply by remembering our history. It's by raising children who love God, stand firmly in truth, and grow into men and women of character. **[That's exactly why BRAVE for Good exists.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e13703733/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9icmF2ZS1mb3ItZ29vZC9zdGFyNDlhNDgyLTI2NjMtNGViMC04MmY1LTZlMjU3MjJkMWNiNi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDI/LbmNsQjcwSTBsRA/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMyMzNfd3Ix/gakbnLA/sco7ee5e479)** Through faith-filled books, wholesome entertainment, and Christ-centered resources, we're helping families raise a generation that understands the faith, character, and values that have sustained our nation since its founding. Because "Let Freedom Ring" isn't just a patriotic phrase we say once a year. It's something we teach. It's something we live. And it's something we pass on. **[As America prepares to celebrate 250 years of freedom, will you make a special tax-deductible Independence Day gift to help raise a generation that understands the faith, courage, and character that make those freedoms possible?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e13703733/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9icmF2ZS1mb3ItZ29vZC9zdGFyNDlhNDgyLTI2NjMtNGViMC04MmY1LTZlMjU3MjJkMWNiNi8/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDI/LbmNsQjcwSTBsRA/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjMyMzNfd3Ix/gakbnLA/sco7ee5e479)** Your generous support will help BRAVE for Good create more books, stories, and resources that point children to God, build strong character, and equip tomorrow's leaders with courage and conviction. Together, we can help **let freedom ring** —not only from our church steeples and town squares, but in our homes, around our dinner tables, and in the hearts of the children who will shape America's next 250 years. Thank you for standing with us and investing in the next generation. In faith and freedom,

| Hello Peter,

When I took office, it was clear that we needed systemic change within Virginia's Department of Corrections. We got to work immediately and the results of the major reforms we have instituted are clear. I am proud that year over year, since January...
* Serious assaults on corrections staff have dropped by 56%
* Confirmed overdoses are down 47%
* Use-of-force incidents have decreased by 39%
* Full facility lockdowns are down 27%

But these results aren't just numbers. They represent real impacts on real people — officers, incarcerated individuals, and their families and communities.

My administration is setting the foundation to make sure these reforms take root — and that the progress we have made outlasts my time in office.

Thank you for your continued support of our efforts,

Governor Abigail Spanberger

Platner, already fending off allegations printed in the New York Times that he engaged in abusive behavior toward his previous significant others, now appears destined to face another round of sexual misconduct allegations.
Women who have had past romantic relationships with Platner, a former Marine who is now 100 percent disabled and has an oyster hobby, now have legal help from left-wing feminist leaders with experience confronting high-profile Democratic sex pests.

That's according to a report published Thursday by [NBC News](https://substack.com/redirect/150aa01b-5f67-489b-bae4-e2806d3e92cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
According to the report, multiple women from Platner's past have connected with the same progressive women's rights organization that helped bring forward the allegations that derailed former U.S. Rep. Eric Swalwell's political career.
Swalwell had been the favorite to become the next governor of California before an avalanche of credible allegations of sexual misconduct emerged, setting in motion a cavalcade of disavowals from elected Democrats. The pressure eventually forced Swalwell, previously a hero of the anti-Trump #resistance, to withdraw from the race and cease his once-ubiquitous cable news appearances.
The same chickens that came home to roost for the man who survived even the revelations of his assignations with infamous Chinese spy Fang Fang may now be headed toward Sullivan.
Cheyenne Hunt, an attorney and progressive social media influencer who previously endorsed Platner, is now working with multiple women who had prior personal relationships with him, NBC News reported. Hunt is helping the women navigate press attention, while her organization, Reckoning Action, is providing pro bono legal counsel, according to two people who spoke with Hunt about her plans, as cited by NBC. NBC also described Hunt as an early Platner supporter who backed him in last year's Senate primary before later becoming involved in an effort opposing him.
The involvement of Hunt suggests that the storm currently brewing just over the horizon for Platner will be harder to fend off than the allegations published in the New York Times.
Those allegations of abusive behavior toward women were based, in large part, on claims from Republican congressional staffer Lyndsey Fifield, a former girlfriend.
Fifield alleged that Platner repeatedly grabbed her hard enough to leave marks, pulled her from a cab by the wrist and, in one incident, twisted her arm behind her back and held her in a room when the two dated more than a decade ago. Fifield told the Times that Platner never hit or punched her but said the incidents left her shaken and afraid. Platner denied violent behavior and described the allegations as false and politically motivated.

Fifield also alleged that Platner made degrading and violent comments about women and rape, including comments involving intruders at his home. Platner, she said, had a well-established plan for handling anyone who broke into their home that involved him anally raping the would-be burglar.
But he was clear that, when he shoved his penis in the burglar's rectum, he'd not be doing it "in a gay way."
Neither the Platner campaign nor the Times clarified the proper technique for non-gay anal rape.

Despite the allegations published in the most trusted news source for the Democratic Party faithful, Maine voters were unmoved. That would be the implication of Platner's landslide Democratic primary victory over Gov. Janet Mills, an election in which the voting data showed zero evidence that Democrats soured on their communist hero because of the Times's story.
The Times report also included allegations from Jenny Racicot, who dated Platner on and off from 2019 to 2021. Racicot told the Times that Platner came to her home drunk in 2021 after she had asked him not to come, conduct she described as "reckless" and "unsettling." The Times reported that other former girlfriends described Platner as sometimes insulting, volatile or unfaithful.
Platner has sought to frame the allegations as part of a broader political attack. In a statement to the AP after the Times report, he said he went through a "dark period" after leaving the military, struggled with undiagnosed post-traumatic stress disorder and self-medicated with alcohol. He said he was "far from a perfect boyfriend" but denied any characterization beyond that.
Hunt's involvement is especially notable because she was not originally a Platner critic. According to NBC News and other public statements from Hunt, she previously supported Platner before rescinding her endorsement amid the allegations about his treatment of women. Reckoning Action describes its work as confronting misogyny and supporting abuse survivors.
The new NBC report, and the forthcoming news the story very obviously foreshadows, lands months after the previous abuse allegations and several months after Platner began lying about his Nazi Totenkopf tattoo.
Platner has repeatedly said he only realized he had an infamous Nazi tattoo on his body for 18 years when his political opponents began circulating opposition research on him.
In fact, multiple sources have confirmed that Platner, who has previously bragged about being a World War II history buff, knew exactly what his tattoo symbolized. One source, an ex-Tinder hookup, said Platner told her he kept the Nazi stamp as a reminder that America was actually a force for evil in the world. Another source, Edward Mathias Kamin III, a close friend of Platner's, inadvertently revealed in a TikTok video defending Platner that he'd known about the Nazi tattoo for years. Additional anonymous sources have told national media publications that Platner referred to the Nazi ink as "my Totenkopf" while he was tending bar in Washington, D.C., more than 15 years ago.
For Platner, the immediate political problem is not simply that more women may speak publicly. It is that they are now doing so with legal guidance, press strategy and the backing of a feminist organization that has already helped turn online allegations into national political consequences.
The question for Maine Democrats is no longer whether the Platner story is going away. It is whether the next chapter arrives as another round of screenshots and social media posts or as a coordinated legal and media offensive from women who say they know the nominee better than his campaign would like voters to believe.
Hanging over the drama is a July 13 deadline. That's the date by which Platner would have to voluntarily withdraw from the U.S. Senate race. Unless he decides to do that, the Maine Democratic State Committee can do nothing to prevent him from standing on the ballot as its nominee. Were he to withdraw from the race before that deadline, the state committee would then convene a special convention to choose a new nominee, a process similar to the insider power play that saw former Vice President Kamala Harris replace former President Joe Biden in the 2024 presidential race.

Because of course he did. Ted would literally throw his momma from a train for a millimeter more power. But then there's a man whose tweet I shared above. He's named James Talarico. An eighth-generation Texan, a former public-school teacher in San Antonio, a Presbyterian seminarian who quotes scripture without sounding like he's auditioning for it, and a four-term Texas state representative who has spent his entire political career building an opposition to--I am quoting his own campaign language back at you here--"the billionaire mega-donors and puppet politicians who have taken over Texas." | | ---|---|--- That is not branding. That is the predator class he is plainly naming. In Texas. By a man who has spent his career fighting it on the ground. Talarico's the one who didn't get on the plane with one of seemingly 127 mistresses and the dumbfounded look of a Dukes of Hazard character--I'm going with Roscoe P. Coltrane--as the press snapped pictures of the doofus and the mistress. He raised $27 million in the first quarter of 2026. $27 million. In a single quarter (we don't know second quarter numbers yet). More than double what Colin Allred raised in the same period in 2024. More than four times what Beto O'Rourke raised in the same period in 2018. In Texas. Want more polling? Talarico is at plus-10 net favorable. Paxton is at minus-9. Among Latino Texans, he leads Paxton by 27 points. Trump won Latinos in Texas 55-45 (but has cratered since). Now tell me, knowing all this, that Paxton , a slightly more evolved mutation of the clap , shouldn't be doing everything humanly possible to improve--not worsen--his reputation? We have a seriously talented Democratic candidate. With a serious campaign. Supported by the kind of money and voters and excitement you can't just snap your fingers and create. And the the kind of moral fiber and mental agility that doesn't go climbing on planes with mistresses for all the world to see. But much like Trump, Paxton couldn't find fidelity without three Google Maps and a Sherpa. And so it goes. Sure, Trump has neurons that run on lust and grievance. A fortress of platitude in his cerebral cortex we're all forced to inhabit like hostages--passengers in the world's worst Lyft ride. But Trump had some advantages in 2016 Paxton does not have. Charisma. Fame. And an electoral college--that much like the electrical grid during winter and summer under Gov. Greg Abbott--is nonexistent in Texas. Paxton can't sneak around an ample popular-vote loss. And with his impeachment in supermajority GOP Texas, he's proven scores of Republicans hate him, and don't fear publicly professing so as they do with Trump. | | ---|---|--- But, to give Paxton some credit, he sure has the grievance part down. This is the lane where the predator class as a whole is doing its best work. Musk fired NASA contractor leadership because he was insulted at a dinner. Thiel torched his own portfolio companies when their CEOs decline to be sufficiently fascist. Bessent leaks on Hegseth, Hegseth leaks on Patel, Patel leaks on whoever looks at him sideways in the West Wing this week--or in the bushes outside the building at beer o'clock each night. | | ---|---|--- They eat their own. The predator class is not a coalition. It is a feeding frenzy with a flag and a cross. Trump, by picking this lout, handed Democrats a plausible path to 51 Senate votes (I'd argue 53-54, if we don't f-k it up). And we need 51 senators if we're going to hold Nuremberg-style hearings for every member of this administration. This is not metaphor, btw. Nor aspiration. We need hearings. Subpoenas. Sworn testimony. Cells. Big ones. To lock them all up. It cannot happen with 47 votes. Or 49. It can only happen with 51--and James Talarico is likely one of those 51 votes, because even in the heat of a battle with only a few months left, Ken Paxton is such an ignorant slut he can't keep himself off an airplane with the mistress. This is a test of the democratic emergency broadcasting system. Only a test. Donald Trump handed us a gift. The only remaining questions are whether Democrats are too institutionally polite to open it. Or too artificially divided now that we've decided for some reason to nominate a few candidates who hate swaths of their own voters. Open your gift Democrats. Open. It. One more time for the cheap seats: Ken Paxton allegedly kept a separate apartment in Austin so he could meet his Uber-driver girlfriend without the missus catching on. He thought he could sneak on a plane with yet another mistress. Not a Qatari-gifted plane, but still. That plane is the entire 2026 Republican project--hypocrisy hidden in plain sight; paid for by all of us; trying to conceal the corruption of abusive men who spout bullshit on tap. Snakes on a plane. | | ---|---|--- Well, the landing gear 's down. The door's open. Time to tell these MFing snakes to get off our MFing plane. Quick one. See the whole board. There are 124 days until the midterm general elections. Primaries have already started. State legislative sessions are in full swing, with more right around the corner, and suppressive bills are on the rise again.
What does this all mean? Our work is going full speed right now , not waiting for the summer. The foundation we lay right now is what sets the stage for November's elections.

And it doesn't stop his Department of Justice from trying to interfere through the courts, especially when more than half of the suppressive lawsuits brought to court this year were brought by the very federal department that's supposed to protect our rights.

name: Phil Weiser
subject: Colorado’s Democratic nominee for Governor
body:
We did it.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260702_3_weiser.TNYQAw&refcode=em20260702-1483&amount=5&t=1&akid=1483%2E299639%2E_M8Og9)
Peter, it's Phil.
**I’m honored to be reaching out today as the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Colorado.**
Supporters like you have always been the power behind this grassroots campaign. And even as we celebrate the end of this primary, we are setting our sights on this movement’s next challenge: the general election on Tuesday, November 3.
**[We’ve set a goal of earning 2,000 individual contributions in the first week of the general election to keep our momentum going. Peter, will you be one of the first to split a contribution between our General Election Fund and Gina Hinojosa?>>>](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260702_3_weiser.TNYQAw&refcode=em20260702-1483&amount=5&t=2&akid=1483%2E299639%2E_M8Og9)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260702_3_weiser.TNYQAw&amount=5&refcode=em20260702-1483&t=21&akid=1483%2E299639%2E_M8Og9)
Our campaign just won a competitive primary that proved we, the people — not establishment party politicians or deep-pocketed special interest groups — will choose who leads this nation forward.
As Colorado’s next governor, I’m ready to get corporate money out of our elections and ensure our political system stays focused on delivering for all of us, not just the wealthy few.
I’m ready to take on the affordability crisis in health care, housing, and child care.
To protect our land, air, and water.
To invest in our economy and jobs, with infrastructure to support our growth.
To show up, listen, and work together — because we just proved that that’s how we win.
I’m ready to keep _fighting like hell_ for our rights and freedoms. _And I will never bend the knee to lawless bullies like the Trump administration._
**If you’re with me, I’m ready to keep this energy going through November. Because we’re going to be up against a lot from the official Republican nominee.**
We’ve made it this far the right way, without asking or relying on out-of-state billionaires or corporations to cut us a check. So Peter, today I’m humbly asking:
[**Can you show you’re ready to roll up your sleeves with us and win in November by splitting a donation between me and Gina Hinojosa? I know if we work shoulder to shoulder, we can make our nation a place where everyone has a bright future >>>**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260702_3_weiser.TNYQAw&refcode=em20260702-1483&amount=5&t=22&akid=1483%2E299639%2E_M8Og9)

With gratitude,
Phil

Brandon Gill and at 29 years old, I decided to run for Congress where I became the youngest House Republican. **[I never imagined that just a few years later, I’d be sending a final message like this one pleading for your help.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/hYPWar3PnDsDAv5XBYDTA3sCZVuJEUFzmPTus0pVlx63BSzzrEj-v3BlaA6QUub_n1v19fdxZmw8aLLhDK58qsJoNjERoQpDaKNm2rRSDJjd5fvumaA6QbsIduU6z14lYxht2BkY-ohilHYAger8V-R6Oo0o6-rzO51w_vvG4dKFtvDkHZ0vteHP8BHwokDR2QgGao8Va4S2xEcmRm_1nOgoeV_zTcP5bJscibFRsbWVZfLtdgV0IH6KYIMxuSMmHYbN8vPSfOQZ0Yp75D8lnc_hg4_bcZ_FSe0i6hEB0rX7rLDjDE5hNNIOa3ampAMtjmub1jd3YadSeD1tE2-2bJSUKKcuLOjzjIp6APTgz4Gb2SP0Fwjvf0KMzuP0LmLrkSALnqNCLtoRPMRtGZnqrEcDBvA9iasGTzn_9DYRrOP7E11LiUsFxJdfL0CUYUxoybtOZ3AqGYxDmmsA9I-wm9IVFEeyb6CAfwoOBHvYlTHwTd49Me5JAVONYizZF150UNWrDRfYpMsJvXMQ7CcrTMEA65d02_LaafMonvsOg0Swt_D_h2oIGdHeQqsVBkirQfrbV54X_Ztg0iCkKPL9sx9ulMWphZdbA_kVABYy38Cmofyq20Au5pezfdnBGgkwwmPI1rDjDeSiJ0SY-H3rQSpNI165Qm2kttGeV3apNkxLUltR4_TT-e_AfVq5o5JL-1jkCODk-seRbWZGpP3-2I7dzEQegrqSMct-fmDcCb5s-ctPJj6aT6l16Keyy7-T8gJhch03zCi4pVyAFXZysUWk2rwdMPgLA3M2kPOLLNtwnwOV53GZtlE8jww6FGSYk46Q0oA8eA/aCTAI_BkXgYvmZk0H8AwkI57Ur75u2Lm/22)** You could say I prefer the simple things in life. body:
| | | | | Hi Peter, I've been trying to figure out how to say thank you, and honestly, I don't think there are enough words. We won. And **we won because of you.** This campaign was never powered by millionaires, a political machine, or–for much of it–even paid staff. It was powered by volunteers who believed Colorado deserved a Secretary of State who was experienced and in it for the people, not the powerful. Ya'll, we got more votes than any other contested race in this primary, million-dollar campaigns included. You knocked doors, hosted house parties, marched in parades, shared social posts, put up yard signs, and wrote and mailed postcards. You gave up weekends, showed up on weeknights, put miles on your car and roped friends and family into participating. Your work mattered. **Together we built a movement that was joyful and welcoming,** relentlessly optimistic, creative, resourceful, and led by **people who refused to believe that democracy was somebody else’s job.** Take a moment to celebrate. You've earned it. Then get some sleep. It’s time to start again. Now we have the opportunity to take everything we've built together to every corner of Colorado. I can't wait. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
---
Thank you! Amanda Gonzalez, Democratic Nominee for Secretary of State
**P.S.** One last thing. If nobody has told you this lately, you should be incredibly proud of what you accomplished. I know I am.
AMANDA FOR COLORADO

Indirect U.S.-Iran negotiations in Doha wrapped Wednesday with Qatari and Pakistani mediators reporting [positive progress](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyczztu6zAQheHVUJ2F4VDm6BYsbqPOaVMKIz5sJpQokLSV7D5QlpD6AB_O_36bbxxT3O5vvHpTWphddrPLH4XXvT73asuzxe07h80fNc8IqC9AF8B5S7PsnHHWsbSdN5JGBUorgO5hwsiKIDBpef2nSathHBd5ZdJIDpeli-akgABRXaWiHpAAAntWuDgKQQzAyZfWF78_lxQtb43rZ8jF-t7mtUvm0dpehfovcBI4HcfRh_x1_jx3gdMrOp8FTnoAAKQBUUrsinH7EVOKVZMY4L5yTL9g-0P_y-BPAAAA___kP2hZ) on the ceasefire memorandum.

Iran Talks Show Progress
Indirect U.S.-Iran negotiations in Doha wrapped Wednesday with Qatari and Pakistani mediators reporting [positive progress](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyczztu6zAQheHVUJ2F4VDm6BYsbqPOaVMKIz5sJpQokLSV7D5QlpD6AB_O_36bbxxT3O5vvHpTWphddrPLH4XXvT73asuzxe07h80fNc8IqC9AF8B5S7PsnHHWsbSdN5JGBUorgO5hwsiKIDBpef2nSathHBd5ZdJIDpeli-akgABRXaWiHpAAAntWuDgKQQzAyZfWF78_lxQtb43rZ8jF-t7mtUvm0dpehfovcBI4HcfRh_x1_jx3gdMrOp8FTnoAAKQBUUrsinH7EVOKVZMY4L5yTL9g-0P_y-BPAAAA___kP2hZ) on the ceasefire memorandum. The next round will follow a six-day mourning period for Iran's slain former supreme leader. American envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner worked through intermediaries as Tehran kept [refusing direct talks](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDty8yAUhVeDOjSXiwX6C4q_Uee0KTXXPGxiJDSArGT3GXkJKc-cmfP4Pq_zlWKK6_2DFm9KC7PLbnb5q9Cy1X2rtuwtrj85rP6oeUZAxUFzwHlNs-iccdaRsJ03Qo8SpJIA3cOMDkY1oLdASgnl9ejCv9EOQksEIN1Fc0aBBkQ5CKl7QA0QyJPEm9MhsAtQ8qX1xW_7LUVLa6P6DLlY39u8dMk8Wtsqk_8ZTgyn4zj6kL_PnafPcErx5fmpGU575bHQyjdP1vNG6VnfPwRH1RXjtiOmFKvS7AL3hWJ6d7Q_IHkZ_A0AAP__fFBwNA). Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz continued rebounding and crude settled near $67 a barrel as [tensions eased](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDtu6zAURFcjdRQuL23yvYJFGnVOm1K45semQ4oCP1ac1QfKElIOBpg5OB-X5UIhhvX2Tsnp0vxis11sfhRKW-1bNaW3sL6yX91e84KAkoFigMsaFz5abY0lbkanufonQEgBMN61lAr_nziSOTu8eq6II5deWieNAavGoI8pUIAozlyoCVABeHIk8GqV98MJKLrSpuK2fo3B0NqofvpcjJtMTmPU99a2Ooi3AecB533fJ5-_Ds6jH3CO4enYkQece2Wh0Mp2Kqy2QqGxey6pf7NWetpYyp09enwxHIu22x5iDFWq4QS3RCH-PrY_CHpq_AkAAP__EOV3yQ). Vice President JD Vance said the diplomatic track is going well but declined to rule out a return to military force if talks collapse. Both sides signaled cautious optimism heading into the holiday weekend. ★★★
USDA Unveils Fertilizer Plan
Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins unveiled a $500 million program to rebuild domestic fertilizer production, warning that the Iran war exposed dangerous dependence on foreign suppliers. The FIELDS initiative will fund new and expanded U.S. plants after the Hormuz crisis sent [prices soaring](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJycz71uwyAUxfGnwVusy70EkoGhi7d07YgwHwktNhaQuH37yn2Ezkf66fw_buZmU07r_d0uQdcejS_e-PJZ7bK159Zcffa0_pS4hr0Vg4DyBOoEaNZs-OC1d95yNwTN1YWAJAEMD81nIUiGgJ6UoHO4qus8c8lJibOMEYakDwoUINKZkxoBFUC0wRLOXsXIBNgcah9r2J5zTs6u3bavWKoLoyvLkPWj960xemM4MZz2fR9j-T5-HjvD6ZV8KAwnKQAACejCOQ5V-21POacmFRNwX2zKf2D_R_9L428AAAD__9_2aFI). Rollins declared that [food security](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2SnDAQhJ9GZKKGgUXeQIETsnXqkJqVRovW-qEkYeru6a-4R7i8--uv-u9jfZAPPr3-UGRdmltttqvN70Jxr8deTTmaTx_ZJT5rXhFwlqAk4JrCOnRWW2NpMB3rQf0aYZxHgG7TaiJ3J0fmPjlSA98t2SfY2d7Q8GSo8_pCgQLE8TaMqgdUAI6YRnxa5ZyYgAKX1hfej2fwhlKj-s_lYrg3OXZBb63tVYy_BS4Cl_M8-5Pq5tOr5dR85HrlBC6XusDlGhS4vI8gcBkELke1JCmlfCTDVd4AZPQh-JykzZFr80Y6Ls0H_8lF7kfdpKMSuVTpmC9MV7Tdz6tUZyUmeEXy4Vuv_eDN_xq_AgAA__8sY4eh) is national security, casting the effort as a sharp break from Biden-era agriculture policy. The announcement paired with a broader White House farm agenda, including renewed scrutiny of glyphosate use under the administration's health push. Farm-state Republicans [welcomed the investment](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFuwyAURb8Gb0TwiI0zMHTxlq4drRd42LTYIMCJ8veV-wld7nKle4_O132-Y4hhXz5xI1Oan11ys0vfBbdcj1xtOVrY38nv9KppBgEDF5oLmPc4y84ZZx1K25GRelRCDUqIbjV9P94e3tIwyPHWAzmQWo1ykNirvgfbBXNOCS0AVC-VvgjQQngkVPBw2nt2FRiptEuhfDxisLg3rD8-FUsXm7YumrW1XJn6YDAxmByG-LYYI5WzZzCdDwwmoc-QDKYNV-Qeyxb2hacnRp68D5Z4K8eWeabagg2OKl_iO6-pYiMGU1eMy68QY6iDZlexbBjiH0P7h7Kngd8AAAD__5vteyA) as relief for growers squeezed by volatile input costs ahead of planting season. ★★★
DOJ Escalates Against Newsom
Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche dismissed Gov. Gavin Newsom's claims of political targeting as not [grounded in fact](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LFuwyAYBOCnwRvWb0iMPTB08ZauHa3f_OCQYrAA183bV8kjdD7p9N193eYb-uDj-omb1bm6mRLNlB4Zt70cezH5qD4-k4v2LGkWIHoOioOYY5i7hjQZws40VndqkCB7CdDctRygv0o1OqnU0g8oBTg3LN24dGocr0Pj9asKFAghr51ULQgF4NCiFAsp59gFMNhc22z3YwneYKxYvl3KxrYmbU3Q91r3wuQHExMT03merUu_L-crZ2LaU_DVm8LEhKb6uHJceU1EfAkYzd3ygs_C38u2wik9uAnot8JjqnzN6YhkiTs0tcma9tOH4Euv2AXWDX14M-o_XvvR4i8AAP__mVd_Cw), sharpening a feud with the likely 2028 Democratic contender. The rebuke landed the same week the Justice Department sued California to block its new [Glock ban](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2uozAUhJ_GdEaH44BD4WIburvtlujgH-LE2Mg2QXn7FXmE20w1-kbz_fuZf8gHH9e_tFmVq5tNMrNJz0zbXo696HxUHz_JRXuWNCPgwEFywDmGuWuMMtpQpxurOnkXIAYB0DzUYqXV6Ba6jU5IGgdnez0u4324oxv7vvHqQoEERNF3QraAEsCRJYGLkc6xG1CwubbZ7scSvKZYqbxcytq2Om1NUI9a98LEH4YTw-k8z9aQD5_i10jh6jCcrhWGE8grOoaTSU9eDlv4Sm8f-ffWVrim4F3K0RNPb5v5GpJ-8YUiw6nJyuynD8GXQbIbrBv5L7-pv1D2Vvg_AAD__-87fBg), arguing the restriction tramples Second Amendment rights. Federal attorneys separately challenged a Virginia [semiautomatic ban](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1u7CAUBOCngc7W4WCbewuKNO42bUrrLD9eNhgswGvt20fOI6SZavSNNF-35UYhhrR-0uZ0aX6x2S42Pwttez32asrRQnpnn9xZ84KAUweqA1xSXAS32hpLwnCnhfonQU4SgD_0qFD9t3LwKNDDYGny0oBAHMHRfRx50BcFChDlKKTqARWAJ0cS71Z5zwag6Erri9uPewyGUqP67XMxrjd541E_Wtsrkx8MZ4bzeZ69pRDfNayJ4tVhOF8rDGdQVwiGs83Prh6udvnlSrceqSuuthJMCzlVhjMv2u5niDHUSbEB1o3Cr8bbHw56afwJAAD__1ewdJU) on similar constitutional grounds. Newsom has branded the mounting probes into him and his wife a partisan fishing expedition aimed at derailing his White House ambitions. Blanche countered that the department enforces the law without regard to any politician's national aspirations.
Boebert Survives, Defies Trump

Rep. Lauren Boebert cruised to a GOP [primary win](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2uozAQRp8GOiMzJnEoXGxDl223RIN_ktk1tjU2YfP2V7mPcOtP-s7R-XNf70iR0uM37t5wC6vLbnX5L-Ne6lGq5aNReueQ_FnzChKuQmohYU1xHXtnnHU42t6bUd-UVFclZf80eNksaO9B6xvM84waLN5gDpPc_DxdejKfK6klgLqMSg8StJQBPSrYnA6hmyRGz21gX44tksXUsP4Lma0fbN77aJ6tldqpXx0sHSzneQ4h__94fvYOlpIjNbK1g8XmVD2_sNHLi0DsN8bkhOWDqq-iMO3Ib3FSEjZifYrGx156Nq6cFCPVq-4m-diR4je8_aDVy8BXAAAA___Se3zp) despite Trump's threats, becoming the last "Epstein files" rebel standing after Massie's defeat and the exits of Marjorie Taylor Greene and Nancy Mace.

★★★
Thiel Warns Aspen Crowd

Tech billionaire Peter Thiel stunned a liberal Aspen Institute audience, warning that [democratic socialists](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LGu4yAQheGnsTssDLGdLSi2cZdtt7TGM0PCBgMCHDZvf5X7CLc-0tGn_-9tu4HzLtz_wMEmV7tRpI3ivwxHKmcqmM_qwjvawK3ETUk1C7kIqbbgt7EnQ0gwYs9mXK5a6llL2T8MTrTjDihxmi3-ApiuxPOkRtQz7UC9M58ruUil9DTqZZBqkdICg1Y7LdZ2Fwmecx0yp3P3DiFUKE8bM_KA8ei9edSaSqd_d2rt1NpaG2z8_3F-9k6tB5ODTq2JK2dRH469KPUMRXi3cwYvoCQOAnNsJBrkUATxETFDdShKRAfelVpEhSeL-OIsEuT67rOh1Jz3rsxLd5H3A5z_RtUfNHwZ9RUAAP__Z0eHAA) are poised to seize control of the Democratic Party.

★★★
Harris Pick Scrubs Posts

Kamala Harris-endorsed Massachusetts House candidate Dan Koh quietly deleted 2020 Black Lives Matter posts even as he [campaigns on](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LFuhDAQBNCvgc5osTm4xkUaukubEi3e9eGcjS3bhOTvI_IJqUcavZmPx_JA593-fMfAOle7UKSF4mfGkMqRislHdftPtDufJS4S5ChgEiCX3S99S5oMYW9a1v10V6BGBdBuegC69bSqnhhvyGYEZZCM7eV6Hwek1umrCiaQUt16NXUgJwCLjEquNFnbDICec-0yp2P1zuBesbxszIY7E0Pr9VZrKo16a-TcyPk8z87G78t55Y2cU_SuOlMaOW-YsytiRfNiEsQhmoxVXPPWIlYfBGcUKZZaxBaPwsJgSOieu9gYaxFHarOmdDrvXRmnZoBnQOf_JPUfx31p-RsAAP__AUOCAQ) racial justice.

* * *
Moreno Revives Birthright Citizenship Bill

Sen. Bernie Moreno will revive Harry Reid's [1993 bill](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOnDAQQL8GOq8Gm11D4SIN3aVNiYw9hskZG43NksvXR-QTrn7S09P79TF_WIqU1p92R8M1zD772effbPejnEdxfFZKXzkkvEqeJciXAC1AzinOXeuNd952rkXT6UGBeimAdjOvHnp8Bv0c7DJI18Hih9CPndZhdAqwJXOrQIOU6tkp_QCpAYJFq-TidQhNDzYi1wfjcS6RnE3Vls-Q2eHD5b2NZqv1KI360cipkdN1XY-Q_9ydN2_ktKMn28gpb5RFwST2zJiyYHzTG8Vmmb8EI3nRjaMSC8V4s_xJaRULcd2Y1q0KR5X-YiobHaKcB-OOwuWTq-Dzftey8cdFMVJ56aaHdbcU_zfWbyx9G_kvAAD__4QYirg) to revoke birthright citizenship when the Senate returns on July 13, daring Democrats to reject their late leader's own measure.

★★★
Judge Blocks Ballot Rules

A Clinton-appointed federal judge blocked proposed mail-in [voting restrictions](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGypCAURL8GMywEn7gBwSZmb9MNLeRenDuDQAGONX-_5X7CSzo61d11_n6v35YCxf2PPdCU5ldIsEJ6FnvkeubqytkofpKPeNW0SiEnLjQXco1hHTow4MAOrkMz6FkJNSkhuoeZf0mP3k8bKrCAyo_TpIfxy3qN84zQkbmrhBZSqq9B6V5ILYS3aJXcQHvPRmEDltYXzOcWyNnYbH35VBz2Lh1dMI_WcmXqN5MLk8t1XT1YCp9Ke7ThZphc7hUmF6HvGJhcXKDYUuQ250SxIfDnCTvyLST3qjyXlFNF4IelwCnyd2oUd16wtkKuUYqVyaUrBvJFIVCdNBvFfuP_b7UfWHwb-S8AAP__Q5SEWA), handing the administration's election-integrity push its second courtroom setback this week.

★★★
Feds Target Kansas District

The Education Department and DOJ threatened to withhold funding from a Kansas City, Kansas district over a [policy hiding](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFyszAQhJ8GOjFCstHvQsXf0DltSuask-BiITHSYeK3z5BHSL07u998n_fpDhQpzR-wels4TJhxwvxVYN3qvlVXdqb0ziH5o-ZJSTUIaYRUU4pT36JFh9C71tve_NNSD1rKdrHqNoBEMBDCgFr1Axppev0Ac_HqesOW7DkljVRKX3ttOqmMlAE8aPVAE0JzkRB94a74bX9EcpAY6jPk4nzn8tpGuzBvtdH_GzU2ajyOowv5--Q880aNW47E5GqjRi77ugnAlRJVLsCUk-CleGCfqnhCqlBFdUvOUeBZIcci7AkpzSK_fBFcINXZJ_RFVN7RJxbng3u3xeJ2UIxUB9Nc5LwCxV9G_oPSl1U_AQAA__--eIyR) students' gender identity from parents.
